svg.title: 众智园AI自主创新加速区 / Zhongzhiyuan AI Innovation Acceleration Area - B - 分布式服务节点 / Distributed service nodes
svg.desc: Civic Continuity Protocol; Decision-ready. Implementation-gated. Zhongzhiyuan AI Innovation Acceleration Area serves as the Open Testbed. Option B, Distributed service nodes. Provisional concept grid, not an official boundary. Public value is read first. Conditional study sequence: N · Evidence baseline (ALT-ZZY-N) -> A · Controlled validation cell (ALT-ZZY-A) -> B · Distributed service nodes (ALT-ZZY-B); study lead: ALT-ZZY-A. Project loop LOOP-PROJECT-EVIDENCE-DECISION: REVISE returns to evidence and STOP returns to N while retaining evidence; production loop LOOP-PRODUCTION-GENERATE-VERIFY: validation failure returns to revision and sealing waits for every seal condition. Public value: Withdrawable service nodes lower trial barriers for enterprises and small businesses. Footprint: Three removable service nodes; positions U Flow: Node-by-node; isolate or withdraw Beneficiary: enterprises and small businesses facing high trial barriers · people requiring a non-digital entry during outages Burdens: distributed accountability · vendor lock-in · unequal service distribution · multi-node maintenance and training Exit: Retire nodes individually; export in open formats; preserve non-digital entry during outages. Gate: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL · BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES · BLK-X4-OPERATING-AUTHORITY · BLK-X5-COST-EXIT · BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION Unknowns: Exact parcel, entrance, alignment, ownership, control and deployment geometry · Observed accessibility, demand, benefit, burden, dissent and distributional effect · Named authority, staffing, cost, procurement, exit performance and independent validation The OSM context is an exact path extract from a byte-closed R005 SVG; the option overlay is not spatially registered. The graphic scale uses concept units CU, not metres. Applicable gate IDs: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL, BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES, BLK-X4-OPERATING-AUTHORITY, BLK-X5-COST-EXIT, BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION. Claims: I-ALT-ZZY-B, U-SPATIAL-LOCATION, U-REAL-USE, U-IMPLEMENTATION. Sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-R005-METRICS, SRC-R005-OSM-ZZY, SRC-R005-GEOMETRY, SRC-R005-ARCHIVE. Bid claims: I-CIVIC-CONTINUITY-PROTOCOL, I-BRIEF-ALIGNMENT-001, I-CONDITIONAL-PATH-001, I-DECISION-REQUEST-001, I-PROGRAMME-100D-001, I-DELIVERY-CONTROLS-001, I-SELF-LOOP-001, U-BID-ADMIN-INPUT-001. Bid sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-OFFICIAL-BRIEF-FACTS-20260509. 城市连续服务协议；可决策，待实施门槛。众智园AI自主创新加速区承担开放试验田角色。方案 B，分布式服务节点。暂定概念网格，非官方边界。公共价值优先核对。 条件性研究序列：N · 证据基线 (ALT-ZZY-N) -> A · 受控验证单元 (ALT-ZZY-A) -> B · 分布式服务节点 (ALT-ZZY-B)；研究优选：ALT-ZZY-A。 项目闭环 LOOP-PROJECT-EVIDENCE-DECISION：REVISE 回取证，STOP 回 N 并保留证据；生成闭环 LOOP-PRODUCTION-GENERATE-VERIFY：验证失败即回改，全部封印条件满足才封印。 公共价值: 以可撤回服务节点降低企业与小商户的试用门槛。 空间足迹: 三个可撤服务节点；位置 U 流线: 逐节点流线；可隔离或撤出 受益者: 面临较高试用门槛的企业与小商户 · 停机时需要非数位入口的人 负担: 责任分散 · 供应商锁定 · 服务分配不均 · 多节点维护与培训负担 退出: 节点可逐一退役；以开放格式导出；停机时保留非数位入口。 门槛: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL · BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES · BLK-X4-OPERATING-AUTHORITY · BLK-X5-COST-EXIT · BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION 未知: 精确地块、入口、线位、权属、管控与部署几何 · 实测无障碍、需求、利益、负担、异议与分配效应 · 具名权责、人力、成本、采购、退出表现与独立验证 图中 OSM 背景为 R005 字节闭合 SVG 的精确路径提取；方案 overlay 未做空间配准。图形比例尺使用概念单位 CU，不是米制。 Applicable gate IDs: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL, BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES, BLK-X4-OPERATING-AUTHORITY, BLK-X5-COST-EXIT, BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION. Claims: I-ALT-ZZY-B, U-SPATIAL-LOCATION, U-REAL-USE, U-IMPLEMENTATION. Sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-R005-METRICS, SRC-R005-OSM-ZZY, SRC-R005-GEOMETRY, SRC-R005-ARCHIVE. Bid claims: I-CIVIC-CONTINUITY-PROTOCOL, I-BRIEF-ALIGNMENT-001, I-CONDITIONAL-PATH-001, I-DECISION-REQUEST-001, I-PROGRAMME-100D-001, I-DELIVERY-CONTROLS-001, I-SELF-LOOP-001, U-BID-ADMIN-INPUT-001. Bid sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-OFFICIAL-BRIEF-FACTS-20260509.
